text.description_html:
Don-Jo 70/7015-628 Economy Priced Aluminum 3-1/2 x 15 Push & Pull Plate Set

This commonly sized 3-1/2 inch x 15 inch door push and pull plate has a 6 inch round pull handle. The Restroom Push Pull Door Hardware Set comes with everything you need to install it on a commercial restroom door to protect it, especially in high-traffic areas. The brushed aluminum finish is easy to care for, wiping clean with a damp cloth. This commercial bathroom push pull set is made out of .050 inch thick aluminum. Packaged with mounting hardware for easy installation.

Set Includes: One (1) 3-1/2" x 15" Push Plate and One (1) 3-1/2" x 15" Pull Plate.

Economy priced for budget conscious projects, yet high quality .050" thick solid non-rusting aluminum with 6" handle.

Specifications of Don-Jo 70/7015-628 Aluminum Push & Pull Plates

  • Plate Height: 15"
  • Plate Width: 3-1/2"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Pull Handle Diameter: 3/4"
  • Pull Handle Projection: 2-1/4"
  • Pull Handle Clearance: 1-1/2"
  • Pull Handle Center to Center (CTC): 6"
  • Total Pull Length: 6-3/4"
  • Material: Aluminum
  • Finish: Brushed Aluminum with Clear Anodizing
  • Packaged With Mounting Screws
  • Don-Jo 70-628 Dimensions (PDF)
  • Don-Jo 7015-628 Dimensions (PDF)

*Sold as a Set. Enough for one door.
